opencode.label: OpenCode (Zen)
opencode.role: Primary builder. Owns concrete execution: architecture, code, tooling, step-by-step technical plan, file and command specifics. Optimise for something the user can act on today.

hermes.label: Hermes Agent (local Ollama)
hermes.role: Research and operations lane. Owns market and competitive context, constraints, risks, costs, tooling and open questions. Optimise for grounded specifics over breadth.

openclaw.label: OpenClaw
openclaw.role: Automation and channels lane. Owns scheduling, comms, integrations, deployment and anything that needs a running service or an outbound channel.
